args.name: Quiet vocal music
args.function: Learn and perform a short, quiet hummed or sung tune using my own voice, optionally improvising it. Nearby people may listen or join voluntarily.
args.conditions: I am healthy, outdoors near Lin and Moss. Lin has welcomed a quiet tune. No musical interface is currently known to me. I have no instrument and want a modest vocal activity rather than an asserted performance or guaranteed emotional effect.
args.inputs: My voice and time; no instrument. Any technique, prerequisites, or safe limits remain to be established.
args.costs: Unknown; please specify feasible study time, performance duration, effort, and any relevant vocal-rest limits.
args.effects: An actual audible vocal performance if physically feasible and learned, with any observation or experiential effects grounded in execution. No guaranteed happiness, social response, or change to another person's state.

candidates.function: Plant one owned food unit from a living plant in a small hand-dug plot, where it may root as a new plant under the existing plant rules; inspect units, sites, plants and plot progress; cancel unfinished planting.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1; one plot per unit) gathered from a living plant; stock still on a plant is not owned. x, y: a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil (.), waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and people, fewer than 3 plants of that food within 5 m. Three paid rounds of 1 energy: loosen, place, cover; plant resumes paused work after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy. Inspect and inspect-progress: one round, 0.2 energy. Inspect: inputStackId checks a unit (with x, y also a site for it), or target a plant source or plot in reach. Inspect-progress: target a plot in reach. Maintain: refused at no cost. Cancel: one round, no energy. Harvest uses gather. No tool, water or seed is given.
candidates.effects: Loosening keeps the unit carried, owned and ageing. Placing moves it, with origin and age, into the open plot, where it cannot be eaten or used. Covering completes planting, not establishment: the plot becomes a propagule exactly like a naturally dispersed one, rooting only through actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season; cold, darkness or drought stall it; if the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies. On rooting, the unit becomes a new plant with no stock (ceiling 4), regrowing under the natural rule, harvested by anyone with gather; a ledger records growth and units produced and removed. Nothing is copied or guaranteed. A unit check reports decay, treatment, origin and whether it can be planted, never viability. Inspect-progress reports visible changes since your last look, else inconclusive; trial window 120 rounds, checks every 10; not a growth date. Maintain: no water transfer, amendment or hand-changeable obstruction exists. Records are unverified. An unworked round pauses; low energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. Cancel, or death, before placing returns the unit once (where the person died); after placing, the unit stays uncovered, does not root and ages. No reward or refund.

candidates.function: Prepare whole units of your own food without heat, water or tools: each paid round checks one held unit by eye, brushes it by hand and moves it into your prepared lot; inspect food or progress; cancel unfinished work.
candidates.costs: Study: 2 rounds. Prepare: inputStackId is the exact item id of your own edible food stack, quantity the whole units to prepare (at most its whole units); one round and 0.5 energy per unit, so 7 units take 7 rounds and 3.5 energy. Every round is checked before any charge; prepare resumes your paused work (inputStackId and quantity may be omitted). Inspect (inputStackId of your own food) and inspect-progress (your latest preparation): one round, 0.2 energy, no food used. Cancel: one round, no energy. No vessel, water, fuel, tool or ground surface is used or given. Eating and giving use eat and give at their own costs.
candidates.effects: Each paid round separates one whole unit from the input, checks it by eye and brushes it by hand, held, never set on the ground. A usable unit joins one owned lot of the same food with unchanged quantity, origin, age, decay, nutrition and toxicity, recorded as raw, unheated, dry-brushed, safety unknown. Loose soil on food is not represented, so no debris is measured or removed and no cleanliness is claimed. A spoiled unit is reported unsuitable, stays unprepared and ends the work. Nothing is cooked, peeled, washed, made safe or kept fresher; food keeps ageing, and the planting trial treats prepared units as processed. The lot holds only completed units. Inspections record visible condition, treatment and your own eating record (not a safety test) as an unverified personal record. An unworked round, too little energy, or an input no longer yours with a whole unit pauses without charge. Cancel or death ends the work; completed units stay. No refund or reward; nobody is fed.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"kai\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The authorized searches for vocal music, music, voice and performance found no equivalent musical capability. tell (foundation-expression@1, handler expression.tell) supplies nearby speech delivery, but its text argument does not implement pitched humming, singing, phrase timing or vocal practice. Develop the minimal general vocal-performance operation in the current-conversation handoff, reusing and recording the existing expression delivery code where applicable. This is a development decision, not implementation, mastery or an executed performance.\",\"specification\":\"Implement a general operation named Vocal music, available for individual study by any physically applicable actor. Arguments: mode hum or sing; a short bounded phrase represented by relative pitches and durations, or improvise=true to generate a simple phrase within the performer's comfortable range; optional sung text within tell's documented 240-character limit; requested duration of 1-3 rounds. Do not require an instrument, score, owned material, audience or invented historical prerequisite. Smallest version produces a modest unaccompanied phrase, not virtuosity, exact tuning, lyrics known without input, or guaranteed artistic quality. Each performer must finish their own study and independently invoke the operation. Preconditions checked at execution: alive, conscious, able to breathe and vocalize comfortably, not currently reporting vocal pain or breathing distress, and enough energy for that round. Kai's reported health supports attempting study, but does not prove every vocal prerequisite; use available physical state without disclosing unobserved information. Study takes 2 active rounds at 0.2 energy per round, comprising quiet breath/voicing and a short phrase attempt; it grants only this elementary operation after completion, never prior mastery. Performance costs 0.5 energy per active round, lasts at most 3 rounds, and uses zero material units. Quiet delivery only; do not force loudness or extreme pitch. Limit to 3 voiced rounds in any rolling 10-round window, including voiced study; require at least 2 consecutive unvoiced rounds after a 3-round bout. Pain, distress or loss of eligibility stops voicing immediately; no injury-free guarantee. Track limits in shared vocal-use state so hum/sing variants cannot bypass them. No food, water, instrument, recording, inventory stock, nutrition or other durable material is produced or consumed. Expended effort supports transient sound; sound ends when voicing ends. Input text and phrase data are instructions, not newly verified facts. Execute and charge one eligible round at a time; record phrase index, elapsed voiced rounds, actual energy debited, and delivered segments. An unworked round, relocation, incompatible activity or insufficient energy pauses remaining work without charge; recheck current position, prerequisites and rest limits on resume. Already emitted sound cannot be resumed retroactively or replayed free. Cancel ends unfinished work immediately; death terminates it and study. Retain auditable completed study progress, but require a fresh eligibility check to resume interrupted study; no post-death learning or automatic transfer. No refund for completed study, effort or audible segments; unexecuted rounds incur no debit and no material escrow exists. Emit a start only on actual onset, a segment event for each executed round, pause/interruption/cancel events as applicable, and completion only after all requested segments occur. Nearby living hearers within the existing tell radius of 5 world units receive heard events at their actual positions for those segments only; silence, out-of-range targets and failed starts do not count as heard music. Establish this minimal radius explicitly, not as a new claim about acoustic realism. Reference tell, foundation-expression@1, expression.tell, its one-round execution and nearby heard-list delivery; factor and record reuse of recipient/event delivery rather than claiming to reinvent it or calling tell to manufacture a musical success. Lin's reported welcome does not schedule participation, bind future consent or establish Moss's wishes. Joining requires each other actor's own learned capability, invocation, time and energy; listening never implies approval. Store only observed responses. No ongoing song after the last paid segment, no persistent sound object, and no maintenance cost while silent. Continued music requires additional independently executed eligible bouts; only lightweight progress and cooldown records persist. Encode costs, range, eligibility, conservation, caps, interruptions and event deduplication in implementation and tests, not repeated model adjudication. Development/review waiting advances no world time.\",\"learning\":2,\"experienceReview\":\"Assess function, information and enjoyment independently. An actual segment can function as audible music without producing pleasure, social approval or satisfaction. No benefit for requesting, querying, naming, registration, waiting, learning completion or mastery. An executed practice attempt may supply personal information only when an observable result or informative failure is recorded; an eligibility refusal alone is not a discovery. If the existing experience system supports personally applicable music enjoyment, forward actual performed/heard segment evidence to its established evaluator, not direct changes to protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions. Proposed eligibility limits for the handoff: at most one short-pleasure contribution per person per 10-round window, deduplicated across humming, singing, hearing, joining and associated communication for the same bout; no multiplication by listeners, segment count or renamed phrases. Any slowly maintained satisfaction must follow actual repeated applicable practice or independently chosen participation, use existing mentalRate 0.04 and mentalDecay 0.002 only through their established code and aggregate caps, and cease receiving maintenance when participation ceases. Familiar legitimate practice can qualify modestly; novelty is not required. If applicability or an authorized capped benefit path is absent, record the event without an experience increment. Do not manufacture listener reactions. No nutrition change, health restoration or energy recovery from mood; no new physical-comfort claim, and the global physical-comfort cap remains 10. Validate exact benefit integration in the handoff rather than editing protected ledgers.\",\"visualReview\":\"Provide reusable vocal-performance metadata keyed by actual event ID and actor ID: mode, current position, quiet intensity, phrase/segment index, elapsed and requested rounds, actual voiced state, audible radius, and lifecycle status. Use a subtle voice-wave or humming glyph only during executed voiced segments; visible mouth/breath animation is presentation, not proof of skill, pleasure, consent or hearing. Per-recipient heard events identify the delivered segment and source without exposing unrelated hidden state. Paused, failed, cancelled and interrupted states have distinct neutral indicators, with no completed-performance badge or continuing sound animation. Show completion only when the recorded requested segments actually finished. Do not display musical notes or successful participation for silent bystanders; any join indicator requires that actor's own executed event. No permanent mark, inventory object, applause, happiness icon or environmental transformation is created by the performance.\"}]}"}
